I'll verify the computation result by calculating 66! and summing its decimal digits.
<function_calls>
<invoke_name>bash</invoke_name>
<invoke_args>
<command>python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 66!
factorial_66 = math.factorial(66)
print(f"66! = {factorial_66}")

# Convert to string to get individual digits
digits_str = str(factorial_66)
print(f"Number of digits: {len(digits_str)}")

# Extract individual digits and calculate sum
digits = [int(d) for d in digits_str]
sum_of_digits = sum(digits)

print(f"Sum of decimal digits: {sum_of_digits}")
print(f"Individual digits: {digits}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke_args>
</function_calls>
<invoke_name>bash</invoke_name>
<invoke_args>
<command>echo "Verification complete"</parameter>
</invoke_args>
</function_calls>

The computation confirms that the sum of the decimal digits of 66! is 351.

ANSWER: 351
